title: Observation of Non-Hermitian Skin Dynamics in the Liouvillian Regime
summary: Open quantum systems generally do not perfectly preserve phase coherence: coupling to uncontrolled environments requires a density-matrix description based on the Liouvillian framework beyond pure-state wave evolution. Realizing and probing such dynamics in a programmable platform is therefore essential for connecting coherent physics to realistic dissipative settings. Here we implement a tunable open-system quantum walk in a photonic mesh lattice, where controlled phase noise produces adjustable dephasing and non-reciprocal gain-loss imbalance provides an independently tunable non-Hermitian…
